name: Devpod GCE Credentials
description: Installs '.agent/skills/devpod/.env' (pass:// references only, no secret values) so devpod-gce.sh and other devpod/gcloud callers can resolve GCE/restic/GitHub credentials via 'pass-cli run --env-file .agent/skills/devpod/.env --'. No vault-path option: the vault item is fixed (see README).
